import pandas as pd, anndata as ad, numpy as np
adata=ad.read_h5ad('lung.cancer.sc.h5ad', backed='r')
obs=adata.obs.copy()
obs['bench_cell']=obs.index.astype(str)
obs['bench_sample']=obs['sampleID'].astype(str)
obs['barcode']=obs['bench_cell'].str.replace(r'"'^Patient_'"\\d+_', '', regex=True)
meta=pd.read_csv('source_meta.csv')
meta['barcode']=meta['Cells'].str.replace(r'"'^[''^_]+_'"', '', regex=True)
source_sets={sid:set(g['barcode']) for sid,g in meta.groupby('SampleID')}
bench_sets={sid:set(g['barcode']) for sid,g in obs.groupby('bench_sample')}
map_rows=[]
for bs,bset in bench_sets.items():
    vals=[]
    for ss,sset in source_sets.items():
        inter=len(bset & sset)
        if inter:
            vals.append((inter, ss, len(bset), len(sset)))
    vals=sorted(vals, reverse=True)
    inter,ss,lb,ls=vals[0]
    map_rows.append((bs, ss, inter, lb, ls, inter/lb, inter/ls))
map_df=pd.DataFrame(map_rows, columns=['bench','source','inter','bench_n','source_n','frac_bench','frac_source']).sort_values('bench')
print(map_df.to_string(index=False))
print('all exact', (map_df.frac_bench==1).all(), (map_df.frac_source==1).all(), 'nmap', len(map_df))
# build joined annotations
mapdict=dict(zip(map_df.bench,map_df.source))
obs['source_sample']=obs['bench_sample'].map(mapdict)
obs['key']=obs['source_sample']+'|'+obs['barcode']
meta['key']=meta['SampleID']+'|'+meta['barcode']
ann=meta.set_index('key')[['SampleID','Cells','PatientID','Disease','Stage','Tissue','CellName']]
joined=obs.join(ann, on='key')
print('joined missing', joined['CellName'].isna().sum(), 'rows', len(joined))
print('disease counts', joined['Disease'].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print('cell counts')
print(joined['CellName'].value_counts().to_string())
print('\\nselected sample disease/DC proportions')
sel=['Patient_005','Patient_006','Patient_007','Patient_018','Patient_040']
for s in sel:
    j=joined[joined['bench_sample']==s]
    print(s, 'source', j['source_sample'].iloc[0], 'patient', j['PatientID'].iloc[0], 'disease', j['Disease'].iloc[0], 'n',len(j), 'DC', int((j.CellName=='DC').sum()), 'prop', (j.CellName=='DC').mean())
nonimmune=['AT1','AT2','Basal','Cilia','Club','EC','Fib','NE']
non=joined[joined.CellName.isin(nonimmune)]
num=non[(non.CellName=='Basal') & (non.Disease=='LUSC')]
print('\\nnonimmune denom', len(non), 'LUSC basal numerator', len(num), 'pct', 100*len(num)/len(non))
# all source tumor same calculation for comparison
metatum=meta[meta['Tissue']=='Tumor']
non2=metatum[metatum.CellName.isin(nonimmune)]
num2=non2[(non2.CellName=='Basal') & (non2.Disease=='LUSC')]
print('source tumor denom', len(non2), 'LUSC basal', len(num2), 'pct', 100*len(num2)/len(non2))
# all source all tissues
non3=meta[meta.CellName.isin(nonimmune)]
num3=non3[(non3.CellName=='Basal') & (non3.Disease=='LUSC')]
print('source all denom', len(non3), 'LUSC basal', len(num3), 'pct', 100*len(num3)/len(non3))
joined[['bench_cell','bench_sample','source_sample','PatientID','Disease','Stage','Tissue','CellName']].to_csv('annotated_benchmark_cells.csv', index=False)

import pandas as pd, anndata as ad
adata=ad.read_h5ad('lung.cancer.sc.h5ad', backed='r')
obs=adata.obs.copy()
obs['bench_cell']=obs.index.astype(str)
obs['bench_sample']=obs['sampleID'].astype(str)
obs['barcode']=obs['bench_cell'].str.replace(r'"'^Patient_'"\\d+_', '', regex=True)
meta=pd.read_csv('source_meta.csv', low_memory=False)
meta['barcode']=meta['Cells'].str.replace(r'"'^[''^_]+_'"', '', regex=True)
source_sets={sid:set(g['barcode']) for sid,g in meta.groupby('SampleID')}
bench_sets={sid:set(g['barcode']) for sid,g in obs.groupby('bench_sample')}
rows=[]
for bs,bset in bench_sets.items():
    vals=[]
    for ss,sset in source_sets.items():
        inter=len(bset & sset)
        if inter:
            exact=(inter==len(bset)==len(sset))
            vals.append({'bench':bs,'source':ss,'inter':inter,'bench_n':len(bset),'source_n':len(sset),'frac_bench':inter/len(bset),'frac_source':inter/len(sset),'exact':exact})
    # prefer exact; then full bench coverage and closest source size; then inter
    vals=sorted(vals, key=lambda r:(r['exact'], r['frac_bench'], -abs(r['source_n']-r['bench_n']), r['inter']), reverse=True)
    rows.append(vals[0])
map_df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('bench')
print(map_df.to_string(index=False))
print('nonexact', map_df[~map_df.exact].to_string(index=False))
# join
obs['source_sample']=obs['bench_sample'].map(dict(zip(map_df.bench,map_df.source)))
obs['key']=obs['source_sample']+'|'+obs['barcode']
meta['key']=meta['SampleID']+'|'+meta['barcode']
ann=meta.set_index('key')[['SampleID','Cells','PatientID','Disease','Stage','Tissue','CellName']]
j=obs.join(ann,on='key')
print('missing', j.CellName.isna().sum())
print('disease', j.Disease.value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print('cell counts', j.CellName.value_counts().to_string())
for s in ['Patient_005','Patient_006','Patient_007','Patient_018','Patient_040']:
    x=j[j.bench_sample==s]
    print('selected',s,x.source_sample.iloc[0],x.PatientID.iloc[0],x.Disease.iloc[0],len(x),(x.CellName=='DC').sum(),100*(x.CellName=='DC').mean())
nonimmune=['Epi','ATII','Basal','Cilia','Club','EC','Fib','NE']
non=j[j.CellName.isin(nonimmune)]
num=non[(non.CellName=='Basal') & (non.Disease=='LUSC')]
print('benchmark denom',len(non),'num basal LUSC',len(num),'pct',100*len(num)/len(non))
print('nonimmune crosstab bench')
print(pd.crosstab(non.Disease, non.CellName).to_string())
# save corrected
j[['bench_cell','bench_sample','source_sample','PatientID','Disease','Stage','Tissue','CellName']].to_csv('annotated_benchmark_cells.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd, requests
j=pd.read_csv('annotated_benchmark_cells.csv')
# benchmark source cell IDs match source format: source_sample + '_' + barcode portion after Patient_xxx_
j['barcode']=j['bench_cell'].str.replace(r'"'^Patient_'"\\d+_', '', regex=True)
j['source_cell']=j['source_sample']+'_'+j['barcode']
nonimmune=['Epi','ATII','Basal','Cilia','Club','EC','Fib','NE']
den=len(j[j.CellName.isin(nonimmune)])
r=requests.get('https://lungcancer.chenlulab.com/api/coord', params={'cell':'Basal','disease':'LUSC','coord':'umap','group':'cluster'}, timeout=60)
data=r.json()['data']
mal=set()
cluster_counts={}
for cl,arr in data.items():
    cluster_counts[cl]=len(arr)
    for row in arr:
        mal.add(row[3])

inter=j[j.source_cell.isin(mal)]
print('intersection', len(inter), 'den', den, 'pct', 100*len(inter)/den)

print('missing malignant not in benchmark', len(mal-set(j.source_cell)))
# if denominator all nonimmune source full/process? compute with all source meta tumor and all source for reference intersection all source denominator
meta=pd.read_csv('source_meta.csv', low_memory=False)

print('source meta tumor nonimmune', len(meta[(meta.Tissue=='Tumor') & meta.CellName.isin(nonimmune)]), 100*len(mal)/len(meta[(meta.Tissue=='Tumor') & meta.CellName.isin(nonimmune)]))
